answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The signal lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the lotus is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the knoll of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, burned when the recruit misbehaves, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name.
